notes: Focused Java public-API case for the HLAvariantRecord discriminant-selection behavior in IEEE 1516.1-2025 §12.12.4.2. It verifies registered alternative selection for encoding and value access. It also checks unknown HLAvariantRecord and HLAextendableVariantRecord discriminants, including minimal extendable encoding, unknown-discriminant decoding, and the pinned Java API's declared EncoderException from getValue(). Both source-compiled Java wrapper overlays pass against the current-source native DLL. The requirement mapping covers registered HLAvariantRecord selection only; the unregistered-alternative exception assertions have no separate Requirements Lab candidate and are not independently mapped.
